mapper.sql: id, dict_sort, dict_label, dict_value, dict_type, list_class, is_default, status, create_by, remark
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '0' ORDER BY dict_type, dict_sort
SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE dict_type = #{dictType} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY dict_sort
SELECT FROM sys_dict_data WHERE id = #{id} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_data (dict_sort, dict_label, dict_value, dict_type, list_class, is_default, status, create_by, remark) VALUES (#{dictSort}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, #{dictType}, #{listClass}, #{isDefault}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_data SET dict_sort = #{dictSort}, dict_label = #{dictLabel}, dict_value = #{dictValue}, list_class = #{listClass}, is_default = #{isDefault}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{createBy}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE sys_dict_data SET is_default = 'N' WHERE dict_type = #{dictType}
